data.name: SafetyFactor1
data.value: 1. Parent/care-provider caused serious physical harm to the child/youth, or made a plausible threat to cause serious physical harm in the current report indicated by:

data.name: SafetyFactor10
data.value: Intimate partner violence exists in the family.

data.name: SafetyFactor11
data.value: Parent/care-provider describes child/youth in predominantly negative terms or acts toward child/youth in negative ways that result in the child being self destructive, acting out aggressively or demonstrating severe anxiety, depression or withdrawal.

data.name: SafetyFactor12
data.value: Parent/care-provider's emotional stability, developmental status, or cognitive limitation seriously impairs his/her current ability to supervise, protect, or care for the child/youth.

data.name: SafetyFactor13
data.value: Child/youth is fearful of parent/care-provider, other family members, or other people living in or having access to the home.

data.name: SafetyFactor1ProviderFears
data.value: Parent/care-provider fears he/she will maltreat child/youth

data.name: SafetyFactor1SeriousInjury
data.value: Serious injury or abuse to child other than accidental

data.name: SafetyFactor1ThreatOfHarm
data.value: Threat to cause harm or retaliate against child/youth

data.name: SafetyFactor2
data.value: 2. Current circumstances, combined with information that the parent/care-provider has or may have previously maltreated (abuse or neglect) a child/youth in his/her care, suggest that the child/youth's safety may be of immediate concern based on the severity of the previous maltreatment or the parent/care-provider's response to the previous incident.

data.name: SafetyFactor3
data.value: Child/youth sexual abuse is suspected and circumstances suggest that child/youth's safety may be of immediate concern.

data.name: SafetyFactor4
data.value: Parent/care-provider is unable or unwilling to protect child/youth from serious harm or threatened harm by other adults or children in the home. This may include physical, emotional, sexual abuse or neglect.

data.name: SafetyFactor5
data.value: Parent/care-provider's explanation for the injury to the child/youth is questionable or inconsistent with type of injury, and the nature of the injury suggests that the child/youth's safety may be of imminent concern.

data.name: SafetyFactor6
data.value: The family refuses access to the child/youth or there is reason to believe that the family is about to flee.

data.name: SafetyFactor7
data.value: Parent/care-provider does not meet the child's immediate needs for supervision, food, clothing, medical, dental, or mental health care.

data.name: SafetyFactor8
data.value: The physical living conditions are hazardous and immediately threatening to the health and/or safety of the child/youth.

data.name: SafetyFactor9
data.value: Parent/care-provider's current alcohol, drug, or substance abuse seriously impairs his/her ability to supervise, protect, or care for the child/youth.

data.name: CapacityChildCognitive
data.value: Child/Youth has the cognitive, physical and emotional capacity to participate in safety interventions

data.name: CapacityComments2
data.value: Provide a brief description of supporting observations and evidence of any protective capacities marked

data.name: CapacityParentAccept
data.value: Parent/care-provider is willing to accept temporary interventions offered by child protection worker and/or other community agencies, including co-operation with continuing Family Development Response/investigation

data.name: CapacityParentAware
data.value: Parent/care-provider is aware of and committed to meeting the needs of the child/youth

data.name: CapacityParentCognitive
data.value: Parent/care-provider has the cognitive, physical and emotional capacity to participate in safety interventions

data.name: CapacityParentProbSolving
data.value: Parent/care-provider has history of effective problem solving

data.name: CapacityParentProtect
data.value: At least one parent/care-provider in the home is willing and able to take action to protect the child/youth, including asking offending parent/care-provider to leave

data.name: CapacityParentRelationship
data.value: There is evidence of a healthy relationship between parent/care-provider and child/youth

data.name: CapacityParentResources
data.value: Parent/care-provider has the ability to access resources to provide necessary safety interventions

data.name: CapacityParentSupportive
data.value: Parent/care-provider has supportive relationships with one or more persons (extended family, neighbours, community members, Elders or community agencies), who may be willing to participate in safety planning, AND parent/care-provider is willing and able to accept their assistance

data.name: CapacityParentWillingness
data.value: Parent/care-provider has a willingness to recognize problems and concerns placing the child/youth in imminent danger
